title: Android Capture Server
description: Packet capture service for Android devices via proxy
body:
# Android Capture Server

A **packet capture service** that provides network traffic analysis for Android devices. The server acts as a proxy to capture and analyze network packets from mobile applications.

## Features

- Proxy-based packet capture
- Android device support
- Network traffic analysis
- Security auditing tool

## Tech Stack

- **Language**: Python
- **Type**: Security/Networking

## Links

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/gnomerock/android-capture-server)

title: Payment Report
description: Getting payment reports from Thai banks with Gmail API
body:
# Payment Report

A utility for extracting payment reports from **Thai banks** using the Gmail API. This tool automates the process of collecting and organizing bank notification emails into structured payment reports.

## Features

- Gmail API integration
- Thai bank email parsing
- Automated report generation

## Tech Stack

- **Language**: JavaScript
- **Stars**: ⭐ 1
